items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: And that was Andrew Brown, he played bass. And he's in California now, Andrew Brown.

ctx.x: Anybody else from Louisiana or Oregon's?
No, there was one bar from here. And that was Andrew Brown, he played bass. And he's in California now, Andrew Brown. The rest of the fellows from different parts of the state.
Did they, how'd they seem? Did they seem to have the right style to hear? Did they seem the same? Yeah. Did they have good swing and all drums?
